purpose: Store user-authorized contextual meaning corrections without mutating raw source, silently rewriting native vocabularies, or universalizing a local interpretation.
writeback_flow: machine produces one or more sense candidates
new write-back Sequence records accepted clarification and scope
affected relations/rubrics/interpretations are recomputed in a new analysis Sequence when needed
future input may retrieve scoped clarification when scope match passes
retrieval_priority: domain candidate if approved for use
conflict_rule: If a retrieved semantic clarification conflicts with current source/context evidence, do not force it. Register contradiction/ambiguity, surface both senses, and request review or continue with UNKNOWN where necessary.
promotion_barriers: PERSONAL/CONTEXT semantic memory cannot become a universal dictionary definition
DOMAIN/GENERAL candidates require R-F-R, counter-cases and explicit user/adoption approval
semantic clarification cannot directly authorize action
semantic clarification cannot silently change Human native parameter definitions
